digest.component_or_area: PydanticAIRunner.run() decomposition in the runner cluster
propositions: PydanticAIRunner.run() is oversized and runner.py sits near the 800 LOC module cap, so the method is decomposed into plain functions extracted along its real seams.
A verified defect leaks an opened httpx.AsyncClient because ProviderSession is constructed at runner.py:301 outside the try/finally guard that begins at 474, and lines 301-473 can raise by design.

Extractions are ordered and stacked (interpret_failure, then build_model_settings/build_usage_limits, then the session guard) so each child commit independently clears the <700 headroom guard, since Verified is cast per patchset and a red ancestor blocks the chain.
build_model_settings must stay pure and leave the _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED dedup-logging side effect inline in run() to preserve structured_run.py's leaf invariant against importing runner.

Whoever relocates a setattr-patched name owns repointing every monkeypatch in the same commit; a49e adds __enter__/__exit__ to the _NoBuildProviderSession stub alongside introducing the with statement.
Comment facts (measured numbers, file:line citations, ids, named failure modes, invariants) may be tightened but not dropped, verified by a deterministic anchor grep over the runner cluster.
